title: App Builder Routing Benchmark Case
description: One representative prompt and the deterministic routing outcome it must produce. These are navigation acceptance cases, not product authorities. Negative expectations matter as much as positive ones: a case exists to prove that expensive or irrelevant specialists are NOT selected.

rationale.description: Why this case is held, in one sentence.

requiredRoutes.description: Task route ids from config/agent-routing.json that must match.

requiredRoles.description: Role ids from config/agent-roles.json that must appear in the packet.

forbiddenRoles.description: Negative triggers. These roles must not be selected for this prompt.

requiredSkills.description: Skill ids from config/skill-registry.json that must be loaded.

forbiddenSkills.description: Negative triggers. These skills must not be loaded for this prompt.

expectUnclassified.description: True when the prompt must stay unclassified rather than guess a subsystem. The correct next step is bounded repository orientation, not a high-cost specialist.
